01 — At a glance

A space to arrive in

The bright apartment is spread across two units: one in the front building with windows facing the street and the courtyard, one in the side wing overlooking the green courtyard.

Both units impress with loft-like, open rooms that flow into one another and let in plenty of light. An old wooden door connects the two areas.

The front unit has a guest bathroom, kitchenette and garden access; the side wing has a bathroom, sleeping nook, walk-in wardrobe and, likewise, direct access to the garden.

02 — Life around it

A neighbourhood to feel good in

Relaxation: It's just a three-minute walk to Viktoriapark or Gleisdreieckpark for fresh air, with restaurants inviting you to linger all around. Bergmannkiez is seven minutes away, and Yorck cinema is right around the corner.

Everyday needs: Everything important is within walking distance: LPG, Rewe, Lidl and Aldi close by, the bus stop right outside the door, and the S-Bahn and U-Bahn five minutes away.

House and courtyard community: Shared courtyard parties are simply part of it – life together in the building is friendly, relaxed and anything but anonymous.

05 — An eye for detail

Does this sound like you?

Every apartment has its own character – this one is especially suited to people who appreciate practical fittings and a genuine home.

What makes it special:

  • For people who enjoy underfloor heating in winter
  • For couples or singles who value the generosity of open spaces
  • For those who like variety and can't decide between two bathrooms with a shower, then end up stepping into the freestanding bathtub anyway
  • For people who enjoy having neighbours
  • For people who like walking on parquet flooring
  • For people who need storage space in their own, lockable cellar area
  • For people who like living independently and without complications
  • For people who want water heated on demand (instantaneous water heater)
  • For people who want to store their bike safely in the building's own bike room
  • For green-thumbed people who dream of a small, private garden with a terrace
